title: Jagged Peruvian White Bread Rocoto Relleno
description: A dense and bitter Peruvian dish made with white bread mix, served in a lacquerware bowl to cure hangovers, featuring a rocoto relleno form without onion or garlic.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the tops off the rocoto peppers and remove the seeds and membranes.
In a large bowl, mix together the white bread mix, queso fresco, egg, milk, salt, and black pepper.
Stuff each rocoto pepper with the bread mixture, filling to the top.
Place the stuffed peppers in a lacquerware bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the peppers from the oven and let them cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the jagged Peruvian white bread rocoto relleno hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
